<parameter name="say">Good to know, Leo, so owl's out. Here's what I got: the shop cat Biscuit sleeps in that very window and is famous in the neighbourhood, and someone said the owner's favourite book is about a fox. A calm sitting cat with pointy ears and a curled tail is a nice nod to Biscuit, and it still feels calm and wise. Elephant would work too, but I'd go cat. Tom, what did you hear? We're short on time, so let's land on one.</parameter>
<parameter name="to">everyone</parameter>
<parameter name="eagerness">7</parameter>
<parameter name="aligned">cat</parameter>
<parameter name="do">stop</parameter>
<parameter name="notes">Owl ruled out (client wants change from owls, per Leo). I'm for cat (Biscuit, fox book). Leo suggested elephant. Waiting on Tom. Once aligned, take the pad and sketch a sitting cat with ears and curled tail, start stroke 1 at the base, split round each side.</parameter>
